data.name: Voice.State.NotConfigured
data.value: Dictation is not enabled on this deployment. You can type everything: voice is an option, never a requirement.

data.name: Voice.State.HowToEnable
data.value: It runs on a Whisper engine installed in your cell or on this device, so your voice never leaves Lettra. An administrator turns it on in the settings (see "Voice" in the documentation).

data.name: Voice.State.Unreachable
data.value: Cannot reach the server to check whether dictation is available. Check the connection and try again.

data.name: Voice.State.Starting
data.value: Dictation is getting ready: the Whisper engine is loading its model (on first start it downloads it, 142 MB). It will be available in a few minutes without reloading the page. Meanwhile, type with the keyboard.

data.name: Voice.Error.Unsupported
data.value: This browser does not give access to the microphone. Try a recent browser or the installed app.

data.name: Voice.Error.InsecureContext
data.value: The microphone is only available over https:// or on http://localhost. On this computer, open Lettra at http://localhost:8080; from a phone or another computer, use the local network https:// address.

data.name: Voice.Error.Denied
data.value: Microphone access was denied. Allow it in the browser or device settings, then try again.

data.name: Voice.Error.NoDevice
data.value: No microphone was found on this device.

data.name: Voice.Error.Recorder
data.value: Recording could not start. Try again.

data.name: Voice.Error.FieldGone
data.value: The field is no longer on screen: the text was not inserted.

data.name: Voice.Speak.Hint
data.value: Or hold F8 outside a field.

data.name: Voice.Hud.Listening
data.value: Listening… Click the microphone or release F8 to finish.

data.name: Voice.NotACommand
data.value: This is not a command Lettra knows. To dictate text, click a field's microphone.

data.name: Voice.Run.NeedDocument
data.value: Open a draft quote or invoice for this command.

data.name: Voice.Run.Save
data.value: The draft saves itself while you type.

data.name: Voice.Run.Validate
data.value: Validating is never done by voice: use the document's Validate button.

data.name: Voice.Run.Unknown
data.value: Lettra cannot open this screen by voice yet.

data.name: Voice.Run.NoAssistant
data.value: The AI assistant is not enabled on this deployment.

data.name: Voice.Run.CustomerNotFound
data.value: No customer is called "{0}": pick one in the quote.

data.name: Voice.Do.DraftQuote
data.value: New quote for {0} ({1} lines to review)

data.name: Voice.Help.Intro
data.value: Here is what you can say, below.

data.name: Voice.Fields.Toggle
data.value: Show a microphone in text fields

data.name: Voice.Dictate.Text
data.value: Click the microphone on the right of a field (subject, notes, payment terms), speak, then click again. Or go to any field and hold F8 while you speak. Say "comma", "full stop", "new line"; amounts write themselves ("one hundred twenty euros" gives €120.00).

data.name: Voice.Examples.Title
data.value: What you can say to Lettra

data.name: Voice.Example.AddLine
data.value: Add three hours of advisory at 120 euros

data.name: Voice.Example.DraftQuote
data.value: Quote for Dupont, two days of audit at 900 euros excl. VAT

data.name: Voice.Example.Dictation
data.value: In a field: "Annual engagement comma file 2026 full stop"

data.name: Voice.Privacy
data.value: Your voice stays in Lettra: Whisper transcribes it on this device or in your cell, then forgets it. Nothing is stored or sent to a third party. A command is always shown before it runs.

data.name: Tour.home.voice.Text
data.value: This microphone tells you whether dictation is on here, what you can say, and lets you hide the field microphones. Hold F8 to talk to Lettra ("new quote", "open overdue invoices"). It is optional: everything can still be done with the keyboard.

data.name: Tour.quote-editor.voice.Title
data.value: Dictate the subject, notes or lines

data.name: Tour.quote-editor.voice.Text
data.value: A field's microphone writes what you say. Outside a field, hold F8 and say "add three hours of advisory at 120 euros": the line is shown for review before it is added. If no microphone shows, the top microphone button explains why.

data.name: Tour.invoice-editor.voice.Text
data.value: A field's microphone writes what you say, punctuation and amounts included. Hold F8 outside a field to add a line or a discount by voice; validating always stays a click.
